कियारा आडवाणी और सिद्धार्थ मल्होत्रा के फैंस के लिए आई है एक चटपटी और चौंकाने वाली खबर! 💔

Karan Johar के शो Koffee With Karan के आखिरी सीजन में इस कपल ने अपनी लव स्टोरी को लेकर एक बड़ा खुलासा किया है।
कियारा ने बताया कि साल 2019 में फिल्म Shershaah के Kargil शेड्यूल से ठीक पहले उनका और सिद्धार्थ का ब्रेकअप हो गया था।
कियारा के मुताबिक उन्होंने सिद्धार्थ से कहा था कि उनका रवैया बहुत हॉट एंड कोल्ड है, जिस पर सिद्धार्थ ने भी करियर पर फोकस करने की बात मान ली थी।
हालांकि Kargil में मुश्किल हालात और नेटवर्क ना होने के बावजूद सिद्धार्थ हर रात कियारा को फोन करते थे और 30 दिनों तक लगातार बात करने के बाद उनका रिश्ता फिर से शुरू हो गया।
2023 में शादी रचाने वाले इस कपल की जुलाई 2025 में बेटी Saraayah हुई और अक्टूबर 2026 में इन्होंने अपनी दूसरी प्रेगनेंसी का ऐलान किया।

क्या आपको भी सिद्धार्थ और कियारा की यह जोड़ी सबसे ज्यादा पसंद है? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर दें! ☕👇

ctx.title: Kiara Advani reveals she and Sidharth Malhotra broke up during Shershaah shoot as she found him 'very hot and cold'
ctx.summary: On the latest episode of Koffee With Karan, Sidharth Malhotra and Kiara Advani opened up about some turbulent times in their relationship.
ctx.text:
Bollywood couple Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra are the latest guests on the last season of Karan Johar’s chat show, Koffee With Karan . The new episode of the show's final season sees Kiara and Sidharth talk about everything from their marriage to their careers, and how their romance began on the sets of Shershaah. However, the couple also revealed that they briefly broke up during the film’s shoot, only to rekindle their romance later.
Kiara and Sidharth met briefly at a party after she had wrapped Lust Stories, following which, in 2019, they started working together on Shershaah, the biopic of war hero Captain Vikram Batra. Romance blossomed on the set. But on Koffee With Karan, Kiara revealed that before Sidharth left for the film's Kargil schedule, the two had broken up. The night before the actor left, Kiara told him, “You’re very hot and cold with me. For me, you’re either in or you’re out. Like this in between, I don’t understand; I can’t do it.”
Sidharth agreed with Kiara then and felt they both needed to focus on their careers at the point. “I know that you’re the kind of person that if I commit to, then this will be something solid. And I’m just in a place in my life where I really need to focus on work, and I cannot allow anything else to get in the way,” he said, adding that they both decided to part ways and see where life takes them.
A post shared by JioHotstar Reality (@jiohotstarreality)
The filming continued in Kargil, where Sidharth shot in harsh conditions, almost away from civilisation for a month. Kiara recalled that she was touched by Sidharth staying in touch and calling and texting her every night, and that’s how their relationship resumed. “In Kargil, where there’s no signal, and there was a lot going on, after pack-up every single night he would call me, and we talked for 30 days straight. So, the official dating started when he was in Kargil," Kiara revealed.
Kiara and Sidharth kept their relationship under wraps before tying the knot in 2023 in a traditional Hindu ceremony in Jaisalmer. They welcomed their daughter, Saraayah, in July 2025. In October 2026, the couple announced that Kiara was pregnant again.
This is Kiara and Sidharth's first joint appearance on Koffee with Karan. The ninth season of the show is its final, host Karan Johar revealed earlier this year in a promo. Koffee With Karan began in 2003 and has since been a staple, first on TV, and now on streaming. The latest season is streaming on JioHotstar.
Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well.

A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism.

Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Film Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day.

Even as his role has evolved from reporter to supervisor over the years, his first love remains writing (and of late, talking on camera). With a good understanding of cinema and its trends, and a keen eye for detail, he continues to spark conversations around showbiz for readers around the world.
